description: Search past Claude Code conversations. Nelly searches through all session transcripts for matching keywords and returns sessions with snippets and resume commands. Use multiple searches with different terms for best results (spiral search pattern).

days_back.description: Only search sessions from the last N days

max_results.description: Maximum number of sessions to return (default: 10)

project.description: Filter to a specific project directory (partial match)

query.description: Search query — keywords or phrases to find in past conversations
